description: Attack coverage by holding a known witness on 4n-2 vertices fixed and solving only the incidences created by the four added vertices in the n->n+1 step. This narrows the search from all edges to a structured completion problem.
mathematical_formalization: Given G_n on 4n-2 vertices, solve for E_old,new and E_new,new such that G_{n+1} avoids B_n and \overline{G}_{n+1} avoids B_{n+1}.
implementation_hypothesis: Recover known steps 20->21 and 21->22 before trying 22->23.
experiment_seed: Encode the restricted completion model and measure whether it reproduces known adjacent witnesses.

closest_prior_art.title: Lower bounds for book Ramsey numbers
A 1.9999-Approximation Algorithm for Vertex Cover on String Graphs

novelty_claim: The search object is the witness transition itself, not a fresh global search on each target n.
differentiation: This is different from Paley repackaging because it uses adjacent exact witnesses as constraints, and different from the watchlist because it is a specialized completion problem for book-Ramsey witnesses.
